sectorImpacts.reason: Global risk-off sentiment and potential slowdown in key markets could impact IT spending and export-oriented businesses.
Rising bond yields can lead to mark-to-market losses on bond portfolios and increase borrowing costs for banks.
Higher interest rates and tighter liquidity due to global risk-off sentiment can increase funding costs and impact asset quality.
Higher interest rates could dampen consumer demand for auto loans, impacting sales.
While oil prices are up, a strong rupee depreciation increases import costs for crude, impacting OMCs and refiners.
